missions.title: Decode the cat
missions.description: Open the proof panel on huhcatonsol.com and watch the image decode from the chain in your browser. Screenshot it.

missions.title: Post your first proof
missions.description: Post about the on-chain inscription to X. Use the Content Armory below for a ready template, or write your own.

missions.title: Drop it in the room
missions.description: Share your proof post (or any HUHCAT fact) in the Telegram group. Let the room see you showed up.

missions.title: Read the fee schedule
missions.description: Open pump.fun/docs/fees and find the current HUHCAT tier. Know the number before you post it.

missions.title: Post the numbers
missions.description: Share a verified metric about HUHCAT on X: the supply, the fee rate, or the measured payout data. Template ready below.

missions.title: Check your own wallet
missions.description: Open huhcatonsol.com/rewards, paste your wallet, see what the cat paid you. Screenshot the result.

missions.title: Bring one person
missions.description: Send the Telegram invite link to one person who would find HUHCAT interesting. Not spam. One real invite.

missions.title: Reply to someone curious
missions.description: Find someone on X asking about new Solana projects or memecoins. Reply with a HUHCAT fact (not hype). Use the Reply Arsenal below.

missions.title: Play the game
missions.description: Open the HUHCAT browser game, play one round, screenshot your score. Post it if you want.

missions.title: Post your rewards proof
missions.description: Check your rewards on huhcatonsol.com/rewards and post the SOL you have received. Real numbers. Your numbers.

missions.title: Explain how rewards work
missions.description: Post a short explanation of how HUHCAT holder rewards work. Use the Content Armory for a fact-checked template.

missions.title: Share the receipts in TG
missions.description: Drop your rewards screenshot or your X post link in the Telegram group.

missions.title: List what exists
missions.description: Post on X about what the community has built so far: website, game, proof system, rewards tracker, mission control. All holder-built.

missions.title: Quote a proof post
missions.description: Find an existing HUHCAT proof post on X (yours or someone else's) and quote-tweet it with your take.

missions.title: Verify the vault source
missions.description: Open the vault source code on GitHub. Confirm the program exists. That is the Builder's Log.

missions.title: Read the vault state
missions.description: Open the vault program on Solana Explorer. Check that the upgrade authority reads 'none'. Screenshot it.

missions.title: Post the vault story
missions.description: Post about the vault on X: the deed, the 420.69M lock threshold, the immutable program. Template below.

missions.title: Discuss in TG
missions.description: Share your vault post in the Telegram group. Start a conversation about the game theory.

missions.title: Generate your rank card
missions.description: Use the Rank Card Generator below to create your Mission Control rank card. Download it.

missions.title: Post your rank card
missions.description: Post your rank card to X with your marathon recap. How many missions did you complete? What did you learn?

missions.title: Send the marathon link
missions.description: Share the Mission Control link with one person outside the community. Show them what seven days looked like.
